caption: The drawing depicts an interior wall with three large archways, each formed by a series of blue-gray stones outlined with fine lines. The wall itself is a pale beige with hints of light blue shading, creating a textured effect. Each arch is supported by two slender columns with decorative capitals and bases, rendered in light blue. Along the upper part of the wall, a horizontal border features a repetitive floral motif in red and blue. Below the arches, there is a balustrade panel, sectioned by the columns, also decorated with a red and blue floral pattern made up of stylized red flowers and blue-green stems and leaves. The top edge of the wall has an overhanging molding or cornice painted in a deep red color, which projects outward. The ceiling above is colored in muted brown and gray tones to simulate wood planks. The floor consists of rectangular tiles, shaded in warm brownish-red tones, with lines indicating their arrangement in a diagonal or staggered pattern. The lower right corner contains handwritten text with two names.
title: Restoration Drawing: Wall Painting
